body:
Concentrated triage batch: → `needs-user-decision` + `domain:ui`, Task — a native-speaker call, exactly as filed: the zh pack renders "report" as 报表 in 12 places (including all three singular report-valued keys) and 报告 once (`console.breadcrumb.reports`).

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
① 项目长远合理性:同一概念一个包内两种译法是最小的契约漂移;收敛到一个词 + 一条 i18n 一致性 pin 即闭环。
② 实际业务拉动:面包屑与列表页对同一功能显示两个词,中文用户读到的是两个功能。
③ 防 AI 犯错:AI 补新键时会「就近抄」,两种拼写并存则各有被抄中的概率 —— 单一拼写 + pin 让错译在门禁期即红。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:一行改 + 一条 pin,零新机制。
推荐:**A** = 统一为 报表(12:1 多数,且三个单数 report 键均为 报表;若语境实为数据/表格报表,此译更准);B = `console.breadcrumb.reports` 语境确属叙述性报告,保留 报告 并在包内注记理由。回一个字母即可 —— 这题只有您能裁(需要母语判断,12:1 是多数证据不是正误证据)。
置信缺口:本席未读 breadcrumb 所指页面的实际内容;若那页聚合的是叙述性内容,B 成立。

Maintainer ruling (2026-08-25, batch adjudication close-out; verbatim: 「6132 6166 同意」— recommendation accepted, and this one needed exactly a native/product call): **normalize** — `console.breadcrumb.reports` changes 报告 → 报表, matching the twelve sibling keys; the breadcrumb names the same report feature the rest of the pack calls 报表, and the maintainer confirms no deliberate narrative-report distinction was intended. Per the card's own framing, this ruling — not an occurrence count — is what licenses the edit; record a one-line comment at the key so a future majority-counter doesn't re-litigate it in reverse.

State transition: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (this comment is the authoritative record if the label lags). Lane `domain:ui`, `i18n`, type Task, S one-line + key comment.

**Dispatched** by the `domain:ui` seat.

**Read the thread before the body.** The card says this needs a person and must not be resolved by counting occurrences. That was correct when filed — and a person has since ruled. The maintainer ruling of 2026-08-25, quoted verbatim:

> 「6132 6166 同意」

recorded by the triage seat as:

> **normalize** — `console.breadcrumb.reports` changes 报告 → 报表, matching the twelve sibling keys; the breadcrumb names the same report feature the rest of the pack calls 报表, and the maintainer confirms no deliberate narrative-report distinction was intended. Per the card's own framing, this ruling — not an occurrence count — is what licenses the edit; record a one-line comment at the key so a future majority-counter doesn't re-litigate it in reverse.
>
> State transition: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Lane `domain:ui`, `i18n`, type Task, S one-line + key comment.

**So the work is exactly two things**, and it is small:

1. `console.breadcrumb.reports` in the zh pack: 报告 → 报表.
2. A one-line comment at that key recording that this was ruled, not counted — so the next agent measuring pack consistency does not re-file it, and so nobody later "fixes" it back by reading the render context and disagreeing.

**Write that comment carefully — it is half the deliverable.** The card's own reasoning is that a 12-to-1 split is evidence of a majority, not evidence of a mistake, and that 报表 and 报告 are not interchangeable in general. Your comment should say the distinction was considered and ruled against here, so it reads as a decision rather than as a sweep that did not notice the difference.

⛔ **This is not a licence to normalise vocabulary across the ten packs.** The card names that hazard explicitly and says it would need its own ruling. One key, one pack. If you notice sibling inconsistencies while you are in there, file them; do not fix them.

⛔ **Do not follow the majority as your reason.** The ruling is your authority. If you write a changeset or PR body that justifies the change by "12 versus 1", you have recorded the wrong reason and the next reader will draw the wrong conclusion about what is safe to do to the other packs.

**An i18n pin is optional, not ruled.** The triage recommendation floated one; the ruling's transition line scopes this to "one-line + key comment". If you add a pin, it must be scoped to the zh pack's report-valued keys only. ⛔ A general cross-pack vocabulary gate is out of scope and would be the sweep this card bans, wearing a gate's clothes.

**Reproduce first**, with the card's own command, and confirm the counts on today's main rather than inheriting them — 12 uses of 报表 and 1 of 报告. If the numbers have moved, say so; the ruling still stands, but the report should be accurate.

**Fence and hygiene.**
- Dedicated per-task worktree before your first edit — a feature branch on the shared checkout is not enough, its HEAD gets switched under you.
- ⛔ Never `git stash`. The stack lives in the common git directory and is shared by every worktree; a `pop` can restore another agent's work and reports success.
- ⛔ Do not touch `content/docs/releases/`. Your release-notes input is the changeset.
- Claim first: assign yourself, post a claim comment with your session ID and branch, re-read the thread before writing code.
- **Run tests narrowly** — the shared validation lock is a cross-agent resource and a wide run has been measured holding it nearly eighteen minutes. The i18n key checks plus the package that owns the pack are enough here.

Thread re-read before writing code: the 2026-08-25 maintainer ruling (「6132 6166 同意」) is my authority for the edit, not the occurrence count. Scope held to the ruling's transition line — one key, one pack: `console.breadcrumb.reports` 报告 → 报表 plus a one-line comment at the key recording that this was ruled rather than counted. No cross-pack vocabulary sweep; sibling inconsistencies get filed, not fixed.

**Reproduction on today's `main` (`9ea4cdee3`) — the numbers have moved, and the report will say so.** The card's own command now yields **13** occurrences of 报表 and **1** of 报告, not 12 and 1:

```
$ rg -n '报表|报告' packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts
1450:      reports: '报告',        <- console.breadcrumb.reports (the outlier)
1556:      reports: '报表',        <- console.commandPalette.reports (near-identical sibling)
...
```

The drift is fully accounted for and changes nothing about the ruling: commit `b08b7eba9` (2026-08-24, *"fix(i18n): define home.recentApps.itemType.report and .metadata in all …"*) landed after this card was filed and added the thirteenth — `home.recentApps.itemType.report: '报表'`, the very key #6023 was translating when it took the 12:1 measurement. The outlier is unchanged at one, still at `console.breadcrumb.reports`.

Review fix pushed — supersedes the previous report. Head is now `f23a70d45`; PR #6500 still **draft**.

The PM is right, and the diagnosis is worth recording on the card: the stale count landed in the one artifact whose entire job is to be authoritative for future readers, while the corrected count lived only in a PR description nobody re-reads. That is the card's own failure mode reproduced inside its own fix.

The number was **removed** rather than corrected to 13 — "against its twelve siblings" is now "against the rest of the pack". Correcting it would have preserved the deeper defect: a sentence whose thesis is *the count is not the argument* cannot cite a count without undercutting itself and re-inviting the majority-counting reflex the comment exists to stop. It would also have re-hardcoded a figure that has moved twice in two days (12 → 13 → 14).

Independently confirmed the third point before writing it into the PR body: of the 14 value occurrences of 报表 on this branch, only **7** are keys whose value is exactly `'报表'`; the other 7 are prose strings containing the word (two matrix-report errors, `panelTitle: '编辑报表'`, the search placeholder and aria-label, `reportNotFound`, `reportNotFoundDescription`). So no single number was a count of "siblings" in the sense that sentence used — dropping it resolves that without having to define the population. The PR body now keeps the two populations apart explicitly and states that neither is the reason for the change.
